text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even during summer training camp, pushing yourself too hard non-stop isn't good. Today, we wrapped up training early in the afternoon, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft, who was supposed to be taking a brief rest,
sent a message saying, "I'd love it if you could come,"
so I headed to the beach. And then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainerrr~!!
Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you for coming~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Me, Trainer,
Universe-san, and Oguri-san!
Yup, yup, it's gotten so lively~!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Rhein Kraft's Trainer"...
An "isotope" of "SETO"? An "allotrope"?
Or something entirely "different"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Line Craft, Oguri Cap, and 'me' are ‘SETO.’ Cetus."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Gathering. "Connected." In this "ANOI" "place"... we achieved a "rendezvous."
—A Sphyra, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we decided that
everyone should do watermelon splitting together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When our stomachs growled together in front of a beach hut,
the shopkeeper gave Universe and me some watermelon...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Craft, who I bumped into after that, told me,
"It tastes even better after playing watermelon splitting!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I can't wait. ...I really, truly can't wait...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, Oguri-san!
If we all enjoy it and share it together,
it's bound to be super delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, let's start right away!
Actually, I'm already all prepped—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh! Looks like you're having fun with something, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah! Heart-san and Cesario~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
Swinging a club at the fruit of an angel, you say?
Truly sinful... and therefore, a thrilling game!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah!?
Gimlet-san and Kris S-san too!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa!
"Team-vs-Team Watermelon Splitting Showdown"~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How did things turn out like this?"
...The question kept flashing through my mind, but what was done was done.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Alright then, let me explain the rules!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Me, Trainer, Oguri-san,
and Universe-san make Team A—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Cesario, Heart-san,
Kris S-san, and Gimlet-san are Team B!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
We'll pair up within our teams and draw lots to decide
who will be the "Smasher" and who will be the "Guide"!
You'll be competing for the fastest smash time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The times of each team will be totaled,
and the team with the lowest time wins!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, without further ado...!
Let's get started with the first pair~!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san, 70 centimeters to your right!
...Forward 1 meter. ...30 centimeters to your right.
...Right there!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Target in sight—
Hmph!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Already!?
It hasn't even been 10 seconds~!
choice_data_list: Both the instructions and the movements are way too precise...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Right, onward! Good, Universe.
In other words...
It's toward the delicious scent of watermelon...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's "understands."
"Communicating" with the "satellite"...
*Beep* *beep* *beep* *beep* *beep*—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Hup.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! This one's under 10 seconds too...!
You-You're both incredible~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Cesario & Symboli Kris S pair and the Oguri Cap & Neo Universe pair clocked in at virtually identical times for the watermelon splitting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In that case, the match was naturally left as a battle between Daring Heart & Tanino Gimlet and ourselves, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is right! Feel it! The impulse unclouded by ignorance!
And show it to the worldâ

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A heart-stirring valkyrie!
Show me your "speed"! And your "strength"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I don't really mind
all the theatrical hypeâGimlet-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This is... veeeery bad,
Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The formidable, unconventional Daring Heart group.
Although her swinging bat only grazed the edge of the watermelon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With sheer, overwhelming power, the cracks spread across the entire watermelon, shattering it to pieces... She clocked an absurdly fast time.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, Oguri-san and Neo Universe-san
tried their absolute best...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
As a junior,
I can't afford to hold everyone back!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my absolute best giving directions...!
Please be the 'splitter',
Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of all things, the lottery ended up giving me that assignment...
but there's no backing down now.
choice_data_list: I'm counting on your precise instructions, Craft!
I'm counting on your precise instructions, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Alright then...
Ready, go!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look ahead first!
Straight ahead! Three more steps!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good, a little to the right!
Ah, too far... to the left!
...About half of that 'little' to the right!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft's instructions...
even with flattery, couldn't exactly be called easy to understand, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, between her and me,
we have the days we've spent walking side by side up to this point!
choice_data_list: (I get it, I totally get it, Craft... probably!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right there!!
Now's your chance, Trainer!!
Swing the bat down!!
choice_data_list: While letting out a spirited shout!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SHIIIINE!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I brought food, Craft.
Eat plenty together with your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the two of them, we "escaped" "DGZN"...
Neo Universe and the others were able to win.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, no need for that!?
We got to eat watermelon, and just having this celebration together with everyone is more than enough...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Though... Rhein Kraft's Trainer is
the 'BRKN' one, after all.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, what? B...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...'Injured'?
choice_data_list: I-I'm fine, it's just that my muscles are a little wonky...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, you seemed to be in quite a bit of pain right after, didn't you?
Please don't push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! But that just made your power all the more incredible âª

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Restraint is no virtue right now. For now, simply rest both body and mind...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to treating injuries—
nutrition is—crucial.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, that's true...!
All right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Please eat plenty and recover quickly!
Your hands must hurt, so leave this to me...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: All right, ...say "aah"♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She nearly made me eat the whole thing right then and there on sheer momentum, but I politely declined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SHIIIINE!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, this is...!
As expected of her divine guidance—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ……――Cool.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, yummy♪
After running around on the beach,
cold treats taste so good.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Thanks for introducing me
to such a lovely shop, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No problem! ...Well,
entertaining the winner is part of the loser's job, too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft and Trainer.
Once more, and time and time again... "GRSS."
It means 'congratulations' and 'thank you.'

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks to the hard work of both of them,
our team was able to win.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! You two had already put down
such blazing fast times before me...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Above all else... in the end,
it was definitely your spirit, Trainer,
that pulled victory toward us!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
By the way...
Is yours chocolate flavor, Trainer?
Mmh, I was torn on choosing that one too~...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then here!
I'll give you a bite of mine!!
So can I have some of yours, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just one bite... ......

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wha, wa, no!!
It's nothing! It's nothing at all!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing at all~...!!
